intuition: At least one half of a rotated, distinct sorted array is ordered; determine whether the target lies in that half.

brute_force.approach: Scan all values and return the index of the target when found.

optimal.approach: Binary search. Identify the sorted half, keep it only if the target is within its inclusive bounds, and otherwise search the other half.

edge_cases: A one-element array can match at index zero or return -1.
Use inclusive range checks so targets at either endpoint remain searchable.
When the target is absent, each iteration must still discard at least one index.
